captions.agents_context: Krizaka Agents sits between a ticket and a merged pull request: agents propose, checks refuse, a person decides.
captions.agents_containers: The parts that carry a ticket to a merge; none of them is a model except the sessions themselves.

captions.alert_life: An alert stays in one table until a person takes it and a proof closes it.
